Perfect! I can see the issue. The pod is stuck in Pending with the reason "Unschedulable". The error message indicates two problems:
1. "3 node(s) had untolerated taint {dedicated: gpu}" - the GPU nodes have a taint that the pod doesn't tolerate
2. "6 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector"

I can see from the pod details that it DOES have a toleration for `nvidia.com/gpu`, but it's missing a toleration for the `dedicated: gpu` taint that's on the GPU nodes. Let me search the documentation to confirm the recommended way to handle GPU node taints.
